'''Update Log''' ---- This is the update log for Tower Defense Simulator, which includes every update in '''Tower Defense Simulator'''. This page contains update logs for every single Tower Defense Simulator update made since it went into BETA.
==Update Numbering Scheme== The updates are separated into five main development stages: *Modern (4 December 2021 – Present) **'''This is when official update versions have been counted. All previous update versions have been retroactively applied.''' *Overhaul (29 October 2020 – 4 December 2021) *Release (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) *BETA (14 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) *Alpha (5 June 2019 – 14 June 2019) This page does not track updates from the Alpha stage of the game (5 June 2019 – 14 June 2019). All dates are in longhand. Each update includes a full list of changes made along with the official update log. Official update logs are quoted, even if there is an error in the entry. Note that a letter entry denotes a minor revision to that version of the game. Oftentimes, it means that the update was not officially logged by the developers. {{ScrollTOC|350px}} ==Modern (4 December 2021 – Present)==
